At r>0 the interval (r−r/2,r+r/2) is contained in (0,∞), and the extension agrees with E throughout that interval. Hence the derivative asserted by F001 on the open positive domain transfers unchanged. This checks the explicitly described extension; it neither adds regularity at zero nor changes the constancy proof.
